name: io.github.orvenix-ai/orvenix
title: ORVENIX: contract renewals and EU AI Act Article 50
description: Find renewal traps and notice deadlines in contracts; screen EU AI Act Article 50 duties.

tools.name: orvenix_services
tools.description: List ORVENIX AI services (Contract Renewal Register, EU AI Act Article 50 review, MCP server builds, ContractGuard pilot) with price, turnaround and scope.

tools.name: scan_contract_renewal_terms
tools.description: Scan pasted contract text (English, French, Spanish or Arabic) for automatic renewal, notice periods, notice formalities, price increases, early-termination fees, termination for convenience, service credits and liability caps. Returns each finding with the clause it came from. Nothing is stored; remove confidential names if needed.

tools.name: renewal_notice_deadline
tools.description: Given the renewal (or expiry) date and the notice period in days, return the last day to give notice, days left, an internal reminder date and an urgency status.

notice_days.description: Notice period in calendar days (3 months ≈ 90)

today.description: Optional reference date, YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today, UTC)

auto_renews.description: Whether the agreement renews automatically if no notice is given (default true)

tools.name: eu_ai_act_article50_check
tools.description: Answer yes/no questions about an AI product or use; returns which Article 50 transparency duties likely apply (chatbot disclosure, machine-readable marking of synthetic content, emotion recognition / biometric categorisation notice, deepfake and public-interest text disclosure) and from when, including the 2 December 2026 marking deadline for systems already on the market.

provides_ai_system.description: You develop the AI system or put it on the market under your name (provider). False if you only use a third-party AI system (deployer).

chatbot_or_interacts_with_people.description: The system interacts directly with people (chatbot, voice agent, assistant).

generates_synthetic_content.description: The system generates synthetic audio, image, video or text.

on_eu_market_before_2026_08_02.description: The generative system was placed on the EU market or put into service before 2 August 2026.

deploys_deepfakes.description: You publish AI-generated or manipulated image, audio or video that resembles real people, places or events.

publishes_ai_text_public_interest.description: You publish AI-generated text to inform the public on matters of public interest (news, public affairs).

human_editorial_review.description: That text is reviewed by a person and someone holds editorial responsibility.

emotion_or_biometric_categorisation.description: You use emotion recognition or biometric categorisation on people.

eu_users_or_output_used_in_eu.description: The system is offered in the EU or its output is used in the EU.

tools.name: scope_mcp_server_build
tools.description: Describe a product or API and the tools you want AI assistants to have; returns a package (starter, standard, advanced or custom), fixed price, delivery time and what is included.

product_description.description: What the product does and what assistants should be able to do

has_public_api.description: The product already has an API (REST/GraphQL) the server can call

write_tools.description: Number of tools that create, change or send something

needs_user_oauth.description: Each end user must sign in to their own account (OAuth)

tools.name: request_orvenix_service
tools.description: Send a request to ORVENIX AI for a written scope. ORVENIX replies by email within 1 business day; nothing is charged before the requester approves the scope. Only call this when the user explicitly asks, and confirm their name and email with them first. Do not include confidential contract text, passwords or payment details.

details.description: What is needed (at least 20 characters): number of agreements, AI features, or product/API and tools wanted
